title: Critical reading and writing for medicine
purpose: Read complex arguments for main idea, tone and reasoning, evaluate evidence and fallacies, read scientific papers, summarize and paraphrase accurately, and write arguments, ethics essays, personal statements and professional messages.

weeks.2: Main idea, tone and author's purpose

blocks.deliverable: Map the argument of a dense humanities passage.
Apply a passage's idea to a new situation.
Identify unsupported claims and fallacies in an editorial.
Week 7 midterm; summarize a supplied study abstract accurately.
Write an ethics response that weighs two principles.
Draft and revise a personal statement.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Write a 600-word personal statement draft and a 500-word ethics response, then revise both using the rubric.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
